name: Bozar Restaurant
dinnerNote: Bozar menu, 7 courses (Horta menu, 5 courses, €195, not Friday or Saturday evening)
dinnerNoteNl: Menu Bozar, 7 gangen (menu Horta, 5 gangen, € 195, niet op vrijdag- en zaterdagavond)
dinnerNoteFr: Menu Bozar, 7 services (menu Horta, 5 services, 195 €, sauf vendredi et samedi soir)

menus.name: Horta menu
menus.note: Not on Friday or Saturday evenings. Served to the whole table.

menus.name: Wellington classics menu
menus.note: Beef Wellington for two or more, price per person; prestige wine pairing. No need to order ahead, but numbers are limited.

menus.name: Pithiviers classics menu
menus.note: Duck and foie gras pithivier for two or more, price per person; order at least 48 hours ahead. Prestige wine pairing.

menus.name: Granivore classics menu
menus.note: Pigeon pie for two or more, price per person; order at least 48 hours ahead. Prestige wine pairing.

menus.name: lunch menu
menus.note: Lunch Wednesday to Friday. Served to the whole table.

bookingOpens: Online through Zenchef, linked from the restaurant's website, or by phone.
bookingPhone: +32 2 503 00 00, office open Tuesday to Friday 9am to 1pm
groups: For more than eight people, email info@bozarrestaurant.be.
children: The restaurant says the length of the meal and the setting are not suited to babies or children under nine.
